subject: BUG-265: capture progress everywhere FIRST - the ledger is not yet a reliable record
description: PREREQUISITE FOR BUG-264 (355). Operator directive 2026-09-06: 'first we need to make sure we capture progress everywhere'. Correct, and it inverts the fix order I proposed. You cannot make deriveXP recompute from server ledgers until those ledgers actually contain every real completion -- flip it first and any student whose genuine work was never witnessed silently LOSES it. WHAT ALREADY EXISTS AND IS GOOD: the server-authority path is built and correctly named. FirestoreManager.completeModule/passQuiz/completeLab each call the recordProgress CF, and ModuleProgress.complete DOES route to them via pushToUserProfile (quiz->passQuiz, lab->completeLab, else->completeModule). ModuleProgress.js also loads its own dependencies dynamically (FirebaseAuth, FirestoreManager, ClassManager, AssignmentManager, ProgressManager), so pages do NOT need to declare FirestoreManager.js -- I measured 2862 of 2867 completion pages without that script tag and nearly reported a 99.8% catastrophe before checking the loader. That number is MEANINGLESS; do not cite it. THE REAL GAP IS A RACE, AND IT IS BY DESIGN. ModuleProgress.js:594 says it outright: 'Remote Sync (all non-blocking, fail-silent)'. tryFirestoreSync is STARTED at :596 and never awaited; pushToUserProfile runs at :604 and opens with 'if (typeof FirestoreManager === undefined || typeof FirebaseAuth === undefined) return;'. The dependency chain is five sequential script loads plus FirebaseAuth.init plus UP TO A 5 SECOND wait for auth state. Any completion that lands before that finishes is silently dropped server-side while localStorage keeps it. FOUR SILENT DROP PATHS in pushToUserProfile alone: (1) deps not loaded yet -> bare return; (2) no signed-in user -> bare return; (3) every CF call ends .catch(() => {}); (4) the whole body is wrapped in try/catch with the comment 'Silent fail - local progress is already saved'. Non-blocking is the RIGHT ux call -- a student's completion must not hang on the network -- but it means the ledger is a best-effort sample, not a record. PROPOSED SHAPE, needs the vote: make the completion event DURABLE before it is remote. Write an outbox entry to localStorage at completion time, drain it to recordProgress with retry, and delete the entry only on server confirmation. Then pushToUserProfile never needs deps to be ready (it enqueues), .catch stops discarding evidence (it re-enqueues), and offline completions survive. ADD OBSERVABILITY BEFORE ANY OF IT: count attempted vs server-confirmed captures so the gap is MEASURED rather than argued. Only when that gap is ~0 does BUG-264's recompute-from-ledger become safe.
